'''Ushanna''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Mirialan/Legends|Mirialan]] mining prospector living during the [[Galactic War]]. In [[3637 BBY]] along with her partner [[Larvon]] she ventured to [[Rishi/Legends|Rishi]] to search for [[Exonium/Legends|exonium]] deposits, using the village of the native [[Rishii/Legends|Rishii]] on the [[Sky Ridge Island]] as their base camp.<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Ushanna appears in the ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Shadow of Revan]]'' expansion, released on [[December 2]], [[2014]].
